subject: CPPO activation preflight — reseller integration & invoice flow
messages:
From: Sarah McDowell <sarah@resellco.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CPPO onboarding — quick preflight and timing

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, ResellCo is ready to push the Channel Private Offer (CPPO) for the Acme pilot. Before we kick off the formal AWS-side setup we need to confirm a few integration items and the invoice/entitlement flow so the go-live window stays intact.

Attached is a short checklist (ResellCo_CPPO_Requirements.xlsx) — items we typically need from your side:
- Marketplace listing SKU mapping (public SKU vs. private offer SKU)
- Billing contact and PO routing for monthly invoices
- Whether Redwood will handle usage attribution or we (ResellCo) will provide consolidated metering
- Any constraints on model variants to include in the offer (quantized vs FP16)

Could you confirm owners for SKU mapping and procurement docs? Also flag if you need a draft DocuSign for the reseller addendum; we can send a template.

Tom Rivera (cc) will coordinate supplier-side billing logistics — looping him in.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah McDowell
Head of Channel Partnerships
ResellCo Inc.
attachments: ResellCo_CPPO_Requirements.xlsx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Tom Rivera <tom@resellco.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CPPO onboarding — quick preflight and timing

Sarah — great notes, thanks and appreciated. Quick answers inline and next steps below.

On the checklist:
- SKU mapping: Ben will own creating the SKU table and confirming the private offer SKU with AWS CPPO team.
- Billing contact & PO routing: Finance prefers invoices to route to billing@redwoodinference.com; we can support consolidated monthly invoices. Ben — please confirm accounting details and whether ResellCo needs specific PO fields.
- Usage attribution: Redwood can emit consolidated metering to ResellCo (invoice-level breakdown) or you can ingest our metering CSVs. For the pilot I'd recommend Redwood-provided attribution to simplify the first month.
- Model variants: For the pilot let's include the xlarge-quant and xlarge-fp16 variants; we'll mark xlarge-quant as the default to control cost.

Action items / owners:
1) Ben Carter: prepare SKU mapping and coordinate with AWS CPPO team (ETA 2026-08-06).
2) Aditya Rao: provide DocuSign reseller addendum draft if ResellCo wants it prior to CPPO creation.
3) Soojin Lee: confirm marketplace listing metadata (terms, descriptions) and verify that the private offer references the correct product listing.

Sarah — if that workflow looks good, I'll queue Ben to start the CPPO ticket with AWS and we can aim for a sandbox test by Aug 11. If you need the DocuSign earlier, say so and I'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Looping in my plan and the minimal info I need from ResellCo to open the CPPO with AWS:
1) Public product listing ARN (or product name) so we can reference exactly which listing will get the private offer.
2) Target SKU mapping file — our team will map public SKUs to private offer SKUs; Sarah your attached sheet is helpful but can you confirm the current public SKU column is the one that matches AWS listing?
3) Desired pricing tiers for private offer and any promo credits for the pilot (if you want to set a time-limited reduced price).

Procurement/billing note: If ResellCo requires net-30 PO fields on the invoice, we need the official billing contact email + remit-to address. For wire transfers we can provide Vendor_Wiring_Instructions.pdf.

I'll start the CPPO request once we have the ARN and a completed SKU mapping row. Est. time to AWS approval is 3-5 business days if there are no extra legal steps.

—Ben

Thanks everyone — summary and next steps to keep timelines clean: 

1) Sarah / ResellCo: please confirm the public product ARN or exact marketplace product name + fill the SKU mapping sheet (one row per SKU).
2) ResellCo: provide billing contact and remit address for PO fields (email and physical remit address).
3) Ben: open CPPO ticket with AWS once ARN + SKU row received; add pilot promo (10% credit) if ResellCo confirms.
4) Soojin: prepare listing metadata update and confirm private-offer linkage.
5) Aditya: draft reseller addendum (DocuSign) and share for signature after the CPPO is accepted.

Target dates: CPPO request opened by 2026-08-06, AWS approval target 2026-08-11, sandbox verification week of Aug 11–14, production activation 2026-08-18 if approvals go smoothly.

If ResellCo can get the ARN + a completed SKU line back today or tomorrow I'll prioritize the ticket.
